repos.name: bellrope
repos.description: Rings a bell on new mail
repos.last_words: Ring the bell on new mail
repos.inscription: Rang a bell on new mail for thirteen commits in spring 2025, then went quiet. Fixed its memory leak, which is more than most of us manage.
repos.cause_of_death: Memory leak in the worker, then no commits after May 2025

npc.text: Properly buried, which I rarely get to say. Shortcuts and pagination were each committed twice.

repos.name: brambleboard
repos.description: Kanban board that grows like a hedge
repos.inscription: The board grew like a hedge until nobody trimmed it. 41 days without a push; at 49 it joins the graveyard.
repos.cause_of_death: Commits thinned to one a month, then a 120 day pause and a late flurry

npc.text: Six commits in September, then the window went dark. Otis and Juno kept it lit most of a year.

repos.name: candle-timer
repos.inscription: Here rests candle-timer, a Pomodoro timer begun in August 2024. It received two commits in one active week and was then left alone.
repos.cause_of_death: Work stopped after two commits in a single week; no later activity recorded

npc.text: Two commits, both named Initial commit. Little work, but it was dug properly and has stayed dug.

repos.name: crow-cache
repos.description: In-memory cache with a sense of humour
repos.inscription: 64 commits and counting. The chimney is smoking, so someone is home.

npc.text: Went quiet for 160 days, then came back with 8 commits in October. Stubborn little house.

repos.name: design-tokens
repos.description: Colours, spacing and type scale for every app
repos.inscription: 66 days without a push. 37 commits from one author, and a README still promising colour for every app. Still breathing.
repos.cause_of_death: Single maintainer; last commits were small fixes and a retry, then silence

npc.text: Last light out was 26 August. Longest dark before this was 18 days. I have been counting.

repos.name: dotfiles
repos.inscription: Two hands kept these shell settings going through 43 commits. The silence has now matched its longest pause on record.
repos.cause_of_death: Two hands tinkering in turn, and nobody left to decide when it counts as done

npc.text: Its last light went out on 9 September, and it has been the longest dark I have walked past.

repos.name: fernhollow-orders
repos.inscription: Morning bake pre-orders, kept by Wren and Pim over 76 commits and 23 active weeks. The 4 am print still runs.

npc.text: Twelve days since the last push, and its longest pause was nine. Still a healthy house, I'd say.

repos.name: fernhollow-shop
repos.description: Online shop for bread and pastries
repos.inscription: Bread, pastries and 142 commits. Three hands built this shop for Fernhollow, and it still keeps its doors open.

npc.text: Otis, Pim and Juno watered this house through 31 active weeks. Nine quiet days at most.

repos.name: fernhollow-website
repos.inscription: Built for Fernhollow Bakery over 39 commits and 10 active weeks. It ended with a handover guide and stands as delivered.

npc.text: Last light out on 15 December. Quiet since, though it burned steadily for ten weeks.

repos.name: ferrywell
repos.description: Resumable file transfer for flaky hotel wifi
repos.last_words: Resume uploads from the last confirmed chunk
repos.inscription: Still sending, one chunk at a time, over the hotel wifi. Wren and Otis keep the chimney smoking.

npc.text: Wren and Otis tend it well. The resume fix has taken root, and I've not seen a wilt since.

repos.name: ferrywell-gui
repos.last_words: Show transfer speed in the tray icon
repos.inscription: Two keepers, 118 commits, and no pause longer than nine days. Smoke still rises from the chimney.

npc.text: Five days since the last push, and the longest dry spell was nine. Thriving, if you ask me.

repos.name: ferrywell-landing
repos.inscription: Twenty-three commits over sixteen active weeks, and a pricing table to show for it. Quiet for eleven days, but the chimney still smokes.

npc.text: Six commits in October. Eleven quiet days is nothing, though it once sat dry for 26 days.

repos.name: ferrywell-legacy
repos.description: The original ferrywell prototype in Python
repos.last_words: Archive: superseded by the Rust rewrite
repos.inscription: The first ferrywell, written in Python over 58 commits by Wren. Its work lives on in ferrywell, and this crypt is kept for it.

npc.text: Its light went out 700 days ago. Wren made 50 of its 58 commits, and the lane was quieter after.

repos.name: fog-machine
repos.inscription: Twelve commits in four active weeks, the last pushed in January. It worked on the author's machine, which is where it stayed.
repos.cause_of_death: Experiment dropped in January after four active weeks, with no successor named.

npc.text: Dug this one in a hurry, I'd say. Nine commits in December, then "try again" and a long quiet.

repos.name: gloam
repos.description: Reading app that dims the page as the evening goes on
repos.last_words: Fade the reading light in over ten minutes
repos.inscription: Three hands and 312 commits later, the page still dims as the evening goes on. Someone keeps the lamp lit.

npc.text: The worker's memory leak is fixed, so the house sleeps through the night now.

repos.name: gloam-api
repos.inscription: Sync and accounts for gloam. 188 commits so far, and the chimney is still smoking, so someone is still up with it.

npc.text: Fixed that flaky test twice. Returning 429 over 503 was the right call. Watch the wip commits.

repos.name: gloam-docs
repos.description: Help centre and API docs for gloam
repos.inscription: Help centre and API docs for gloam, kept by two hands over 64 commits. The lamp is low, but the smoke still rises.

npc.text: Juno waters most of this bed, 49 of 64 commits. It went dry for 18 days once, then came back up.

repos.name: gloam-landing
repos.last_words: Swap the hero screenshot for the autumn release
repos.inscription: Forty-six commits, two keepers, and the chimney still smokes. The porch light stays on for visitors.

npc.text: A 39 day dry spell once, but it came back green. Someone fixed the crash on empty input twice.

repos.name: gloam-v1
repos.last_words: Point the README to the new gloam repo
repos.inscription: First version of gloam, kept by Wren and Juno across 74 commits. The lamp now burns in gloam, its successor.

npc.text: Not dug in a hurry. Its last commit pointed the README at gloam, the proper way to leave.

repos.name: gravel-sh
repos.inscription: Buried by hand, though it never really died. Fifteen commits, one of them 'try again', and no push in 130 days.
repos.cause_of_death: Momentum ran out in June, mid-refactor by the look of 'wip' and 'try again'.

npc.text: Dug this one in a hurry. Fifteen commits, and one of them still says try again.

repos.name: hearthbook
repos.description: Recipe book for families who share one kitchen
repos.last_words: Scale ingredient amounts when servings change
repos.inscription: Recipes for families who share one kitchen. Three cooks, 156 commits, and the chimney is still smoking.

npc.text: Three gardeners in this bed, Otis the busiest. Watered three days back, still standing tall.

repos.name: hearthbook-ios
repos.last_words: Keep the screen awake while cooking
repos.inscription: 92 commits from two pairs of hands, and the chimney still smokes. The screen stays awake while the pot is on.

npc.text: Thirty active weeks of watering. Otis and Juno take turns. Even the wip commits got a drink.

repos.name: hearthbook-landing
repos.last_words: Translate the landing page to Dutch
repos.inscription: Juno keeps the hearthbook landing page warm across 31 commits, through one 34 day lull, with smoke still rising from the chimney.

npc.text: Juno waters it in bursts. Seven commits in August, then a long dry spell. Still green, though.

repos.name: hearthbook-proto
repos.last_words: Last prototype build before the Kotlin rewrite
repos.inscription: Ancestor of hearthbook. Its clickable prototype took 22 commits to build, and the work lives on there.
repos.cause_of_death: Superseded by hearthbook after the Kotlin rewrite.

npc.text: Its light went out on purpose, after one last build ahead of the Kotlin rewrite. I still checked.

repos.name: hollow-icons
repos.inscription: Here rest the outlines of an icon set: 27 commits between March and July 2025, and a README that never grew past one line.
repos.cause_of_death: Went quiet after July 2025; the README never got past one line.

npc.text: Its light went out in July 2025. I still notice the gap in the lane at night.

repos.name: infra
repos.description: Servers, DNS and databases as code
repos.last_words: Raise the database disk to 40 GB
repos.inscription: Servers, DNS and databases kept as code by one keeper. 204 commits in, and the chimney is still smoking.

npc.text: Wren raised the database disk to 40 GB. The bed is well fed, and it has not been dry for long.

repos.name: inkpot-cli
repos.inscription: Nineteen commits, one keeper, and a chimney that still smokes. The lamp has been low for eight days.

npc.text: Ten commits in October and the runtime pinned twice so it stays put. Standing up straight.

repos.name: kettle-classic
repos.description: Shopping list web app, the Rails years
repos.inscription: The Rails years of the shopping list, 61 commits strong. Its work lives on in kettle-sync, its successor.

npc.text: Last light out in April 2025, after the gems were frozen. The lamp burns on in kettle-sync.

repos.name: kettle-sync
repos.description: Keeps shared shopping lists in sync
repos.last_words: Log sync conflicts instead of raising
repos.inscription: Keeps shared shopping lists in step. Quiet for 48 days, but the light is still on for whoever comes back.

npc.text: 48 days without a push, yet the site still answers. Wren and Bex left good soil here.

repos.name: lamplighter
repos.inscription: Smoke still rises from the chimney. Seventy-three commits, two keepers, and a sync queue that no longer races.

npc.text: Seventeen dry days once. Wren and Otis watered it back, and it has stayed green since.

repos.name: lanternfish
repos.description: Night sky companion for the phone
repos.inscription: The light is still on. 97 commits by Otis and Juno, and the sky is still being watched.

npc.text: Passed the house again last night. Light still on. 64 days quiet, and I still look up.

repos.name: lanternfish-landing
repos.inscription: The light is still on. Eighteen commits over eleven active weeks, one author, and the site still answers.

npc.text: The site still answers and the light is on. Nothing is wilting, only resting. I'll keep watering.

repos.name: magpie-scraper
repos.inscription: Collects shiny links. 38 commits over 23 active weeks, and the smoke is still rising from the chimney.

npc.text: Nineteen quiet days once, and it still came back up. Runtime pinned, so it sleeps well.

repos.name: midnight-chess
repos.description: Chess engine that only plays after dark
repos.inscription: Here lies a chess engine that only played after dark. Thirty-four commits over eleven active weeks, and it resigned politely.
repos.cause_of_death: Ran out of evenings. Last words: a polite resignation and small fixes.

npc.text: Dug this one in a hurry. Thirty-four commits, and the recent ones say 'more wip'.

repos.name: moorwatch
repos.last_words: TODO: ask someone about the API pricing
repos.inscription: Here rests moorwatch, who warned hikers about the weather across 96 commits. Pricing remained a TODO.
repos.cause_of_death: Stalled after a TODO about API pricing; nobody pushed again

npc.text: Ended on a TODO about pricing, right after removing dead code. I dug this one in a hurry.

repos.name: moorwatch-landing
repos.inscription: Fourteen commits over seven active weeks, all by Juno. The README runs to one sentence and says what it is.
repos.cause_of_death: Commits thinned every month, then the pushes stopped in March.

npc.text: The last light on this lane went out on 15 March. Fourteen commits, then a long dark.

repos.name: moss-render
repos.inscription: 77 commits, 72 of them from Wren, and the shadow pass was left half finished. The chart is not encouraging.
repos.cause_of_death: Shadow pass stopped halfway; no pushes in 74 days

npc.text: Lit on and off from January to August. The last light went out halfway through the shadow pass.

repos.name: night-shift
repos.inscription: Twenty-one commits over six active weeks, and the chimney still smokes. Sleeping, not gone.

npc.text: Two wip commits, a flaky test fixed twice, a race fixed in the queue. The lamp still burns.

repos.name: nightjar-wiki
repos.inscription: The old team wiki. Its final commit made it read only, and nobody came back to it.
repos.cause_of_death: Last commit made it read only; no one pushed again after May 2024.

npc.text: Last light went out in May 2024. Read only mode was its final commit, and I saw nothing after.

repos.name: owl-pager
repos.description: Pages you at night, but quietly
repos.inscription: Three commits in one active week, a one-line README, and then the night stayed quiet. Rest well.
repos.cause_of_death: Three days of experiments, then no return. The README never grew past one line.

npc.text: Its light went out on the 26th of September. I noticed from the lane. I always notice.

repos.name: puddle-db
repos.inscription: Here lies a key value store that called itself very shallow in its README, and meant it. Nine commits, one author, March 2025.
repos.cause_of_death: Abandoned in March 2025 after four active weeks, with no finish line

npc.text: Light went out in March 2025. Nine commits, then dark. I still glance at that window on my rounds.

repos.name: quillmere-edi
repos.description: EDI messages to and from carriers
repos.inscription: Built for Quillmere Freight: 57 commits across 18 active weeks. Delivered, and kept standing as a monument.

npc.text: Its light went out in September, and it has been dark since. Still, it was kept in good order.

repos.name: quillmere-portal
repos.inscription: Built for Quillmere Freight by three hands over 203 commits. Final release 1.8.0 shipped, and it has stood since.

npc.text: Its lamp went out after the final release, 1.8.0. Never once sat idle longer than eight days.

repos.name: quillmere-tracking
repos.inscription: 118 commits of pallet tracking and one sync race fixed. The bays are still being counted.

npc.text: Forty weeks of watering, and one dry spell of 130 days. It came back green, which is all I ask.

repos.name: rune-parser
repos.inscription: Here lies the lexer, rewritten in parts, after 180 commits of honest effort. Rest well.
repos.cause_of_death: Lexer rewrite, part 4, never reached its end

npc.text: Dug this one myself. The lexer was half torn out, and no one came back to finish it.

repos.name: saltgrove-app
repos.description: Try on frames with the camera
repos.inscription: Where frames are tried on through the camera. Built by Otis and Juno over 64 commits for Saltgrove Opticians.

npc.text: Otis and Juno kept this one watered well. Twenty quiet days is a dry spell, not yet a wilt.

repos.name: saltgrove-booking
repos.last_words: Send a reminder two days before
repos.inscription: Built for Saltgrove Opticians: 88 commits over 30 active weeks, and never a pause longer than 10 days.

npc.text: Two hands kept this one lit, Otis and Pim Larkspur. The light went out in March and I noticed.

repos.name: shipwright
repos.last_words: Retry the health check three times before rollback
repos.inscription: Helpers for releasing and rolling back, tended by Wren and Otis across sixty-seven commits. The chimney is smoking.

npc.text: Pagination was fixed twice and rollbacks now retry the health check first. Someone is minding it.

repos.name: sparrow-chat
repos.inscription: Group chat for small teams. Three authors, 210 commits and 69 active weeks, and the README never needed more than one line.
repos.cause_of_death: Public server shut down; commit pace thinned out through late 2024

npc.text: Commits dwindled from 19 in August 2024 to 4 in December. Then the public server went dark.

repos.name: status-page
repos.inscription: Still lit. Otis left 29 commits here, and the page still answers when you knock on it.

npc.text: 95 days since the last push, and the light in that window is still on. I notice when they go out.

repos.name: sundial-api
repos.last_words: Move time zone data to a gem
repos.inscription: Quiet for 58 days, with 32 left before the grave. Its last commit moved the time zone data into a gem.
repos.cause_of_death: Its core data moved into a gem, leaving the service little to do

npc.text: Its last light went out 3 September. Two commits that month, then the lane stayed dark.

repos.name: tallowmoor-handbook
repos.inscription: How we work, written down so nobody has to ask twice. Three hands have kept the lamp lit.

npc.text: Juno did most of the watering. 42 days went dry once, and I still think about it.

repos.name: tallowmoor-website
repos.inscription: Our own house, raised by Juno and Otis over 54 commits. The chimney still smokes and the lamp is still on.

npc.text: Most months it gets a few commits. It went 29 days dry once and still came back up nicely.

repos.name: teacup-orm
repos.description: An ORM that fits in a teacup
repos.inscription: Forty-one commits and twenty-two active weeks, and the kettle is still on. Keep an eye on the worker's memory.

npc.text: The worker's memory leak was fixed twice, so I keep an eye on that root. Otis still waters it.

repos.name: thimble-vm
repos.description: The smallest virtual machine we could think of
repos.inscription: Here lies the smallest virtual machine we could think of. Four commits in one week; the opcode table stayed half done.
repos.cause_of_death: Abandoned mid-build after one week; the opcode table was never finished.

npc.text: Dug this one in a hurry. Four commits, one week, and the opcode table still half finished.

repos.name: tindervale-members
repos.last_words: Export members for the annual meeting
repos.inscription: Delivered to the Tindervale Rowing Club with 71 commits from two hands. The final push exported the list for the annual meeting.

npc.text: Its light went out in June 2025 after the export. Still standing, so I pass it every night.

repos.name: tindervale-regatta
repos.last_words: Live lane times on the big screen
repos.inscription: Regatta results for Tindervale Rowing Club, built by Otis and Juno over twelve active weeks. Still rowing between heats.

npc.text: 26 days since the last push, and still no wilting. Otis and Juno kept the beds tidy.

repos.name: tindervale-site
repos.inscription: For Tindervale Rowing Club, built by Juno in six active weeks. Delivered, and standing as handed over.

npc.text: Its last light went out in June. Between commits it never sat dark longer than three days.

repos.name: wickstat
repos.last_words: Upgrade Phoenix and fix the broken charts
repos.inscription: A light is still on in this house. Fifty-two commits, a worker's memory leak patched twice, and the site still answers.

npc.text: Wren watered this one all winter. Quiet 38 days, but the site still answers. Not wilting yet.

repos.name: willow-ml
repos.description: Predicts when the willow loses its leaves
repos.last_words: Train on the full dataset tonight
repos.inscription: Forty-six commits over thirteen weeks spent guessing when the willow lets go. Buried by hand, though the willow kept its leaves.
repos.cause_of_death: Experiment set aside after its October push; no client, no successor

npc.text: Seventeen commits in September, then three in October. I dug this one by hand, and quickly.
